tray_deck.basis: deck plane down to the pocket floor plane between pockets — the full solid land

pocket_floor.basis: pocket floor plane to the tray underside

pocket_wall_at_mouth.basis: half the ligament between two adjacent pocket mouths

pocket_wall_at_floor_tangent.basis: half-pitch minus the flat floor radius

outer_floor.basis: full tray section outboard of the pan field

fillet_transition_rim.basis: deck plane to the rim fillet's lower tangent

fillet_transition_floor.basis: floor fillet upper tangent to the underside

hinge_interface_local.basis: full tray section plus the declared hinge reinforcement band (interface is declared, not modelled)

clasp_interface_local.basis: full tray section plus the declared clasp reinforcement band (interface is declared, not modelled)

abrupt_transitions.location: pocket floor into the inter-pocket land

all_transitions.location: pocket floor into the inter-pocket land
pocket wall into the outer solid margin

claim_limit: sink and warpage are RISK CLASSIFICATIONS from section thickness only. No mould-flow simulation was run, so no sink is asserted as fact.

findings.message: pocket_wall_at_mouth is 0.96637 mm, below the 1.0 mm minimum wall policy for ABS. Mouldable but at the low end; it is a consequence of correcting the pocket to the fit datum, which widened the cavity.
section thickness ratio 5.85:1 exceeds the 2.5:1 policy limit (thinnest 0.96637 mm in pocket_wall_at_mouth, thickest 5.65 mm in outer_floor). The premium pilot fails until a mitigation is documented.
pocket floor into the inter-pocket land: 4.65:1 over 0.6 mm

mitigation_options_not_applied: coring the underside to a uniform nominal wall
ribs on the cored underside (only with structural justification — cosmetic ribs are a defect)
gradual section transitions at the pocket-to-land boundary
